centralEntity.name: Academic CV
centralEntity.definition: A comprehensive document presenting a researcher's complete scholarly history including publications, teaching, grants, awards, and service for evaluation in higher education.
centralEntity.disambiguation: Not an industry resume. An academic CV has no page limit and grows throughout an academic career.

interlinkingRules.pillarToCluster: Each pillar (P*-00) links to ALL 24 clusters in its pillar
interlinkingRules.clusterToPillar: Every cluster links back to its pillar hub within first 200 words
interlinkingRules.crossPillar: Every article includes 1-2 links to articles in different pillars based on entity overlap
interlinkingRules.ctaLink: Every article ends with CTA linking to CVScholar registration
anchorTextRules: Match anchor text to target page H1 or central entity phrase
Never use generic anchors (click here, read more, learn more)
Include entity + attribute in anchor text for semantic weight
Vary anchor text across linking pages to avoid footprint
mandatoryLinksPerArticle: 1-2 links to related clusters in same pillar
1 link to cluster in different pillar (contextual bridge)
